composition_label: Behavioral personalization -> Document review -> Guided setup -> Web research

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch within the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Strict root fields: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, as_of (timezone-aware ISO 8601), candidates, behavior, requirements, documents, onboarding, research. See the fully synthetic example.
shared_schema.identifiers: Unique within each collection; references are validated; every requirement is attached to a candidate and at least one setup step.
shared_schema.output: Root schema_version, status, synthetic, as_of and stages. Every stage has schema_version, stage, items and summary. Errors contain schema_version, status=error, and error.type/message.
shared_schema.validation: Shared Schema class validates all input before work, then validates each stage envelope and its cross-stage references before the next stage consumes it. Rejects unknown/missing fields, invalid references, cycles, duplicate IDs/JSON keys, naive/future timestamps, nonfinite numbers, invalid URLs and inconsistent completion.
shared_schema.bounds: CLI input capped at 2000000 bytes; strings capped at 200000 characters; each input/output array capped at 1000 items. Oversized generated output is rejected rather than silently truncated.
shared_schema.json_output: Exactly one JSON object on stdout; success exit 0; file/validation errors exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs.payload: Validated ranking and ordered deduplicated requirement IDs; review preserves this priority and candidate traces.
Validated evidence states and stable gap IDs; completed steps require covered evidence and completed prerequisites.
Only validated ready steps with open review gaps become research targets; prerequisite-blocked and completed steps are excluded. Findings retain step, requirement and gap IDs.

behavior.ranking: Sum weight * similarity * 2^(-age_days/half_life_days), browse=1, purchase=3, exact candidate similarity=1, same category=0.25, unrelated category=0. Sum in event-ID order; round to 10 decimals; ties use candidate ID.
behavior.cold_start: When no positive score remains, use stable candidate-ID ordering; no inferred interests or fabricated events.
behavior.review: Case-insensitive literal substring checks of explicitly linked documents. At least one document must contain every required term. Evidence includes document IDs, matched and missing terms. No certification claims; negation and semantic truth are not evaluated.
behavior.guided: Priority-aware topological traversal. Completion flags represent explicit acknowledgments, checked against evidence and prerequisite completion. Output has completed/ready/blocked states and completion fraction. State is supplied in input and returned in output, not stored in a database.
behavior.web: Exact-host allowlisted HTTPS ingestion and offline retrieval from supplied synthetic snapshots only. Credentials, fragments, unsafe schemes, nondefault ports and control characters are rejected. Canonical host/default-port normalization; no redirects or DNS. Missing snapshots and absent source URLs remain traceable findings.
behavior.provenance: Canonical source URL, supplied retrieval timestamp, SHA-256 of full UTF-8 snapshot, up to 500-character prefix excerpt, matched/missing terms and source=synthetic_fixture. Hashes provide reproducibility, not independent authenticity.
behavior.research_effect: Research does not resolve evidence gaps, complete steps or assert factual truth.
behavior.determinism: Fixed input as_of; no wall clock, random ranking, network or model calls.

included: Synthetic fixture input and offline source snapshots
Allowlisted URL ingestion and provenance-preserving fixture retrieval
excluded: Live HTTP retrieval, crawling, redirects or DNS
LLM/provider calls or injected model steps
Production personalization, authentication, databases or enterprise deployment
Persistent onboarding storage outside user-managed input/output
